triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The pre-fix composition conditioned the Brazil IEEPA carve-out on the witness exemplar flag `entry_is_line_b` rather than on Section 232 aluminum membership, so it charged the 40% Brazil surcharge on aluminum articles that headings 9903.01.83 / 9903.85.02 except from heading 9903.01.77.

Only cosmetic difference from ch98: this file writes version windows as `from: '2026-02-15'` instead of `effective_from:`, and the parenthesis padding differs by one; nothing else in the module changed. Corpus reads and the untraceable_branch vs wrong_entity_or_scope caveat from index 96 apply unchanged.
triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as provenance-only or as new coverage and could not: two derived-rule formulas (`ieepa_component_rate` and `ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions`) change their gating predicate from the witness exemplar flag `entry_is_line_b` to the membership predicate `entry_is_section_232_aluminum`, which is a change in encoded meaning, not bookkeeping. The module already carried the proof atom for this carve-out (`corpus_citation_path: us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-219`, excerpt "The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02."), and I confirmed that text verbatim in the pinned release (note (x)(vii) at `us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-220` of `us-rulespec-2026-08-08-obbb-alien-snap`), so the module claimed the exception while gating it on a token with no statutory referent — any §232 aluminum entry other than the witness's line B was charged the Brazil 40%. `entry_is_line_b` has no basis in the cited source and the fix re-grounds it, which is the untraceable_branch definition rather than wrong_entity_or_scope (no legitimate source-grounded population was swapped for another). The other half of the diff — re-pointing the steel parameter proof from 9903.81.87/.88 to 9903.82.02 with `formula: '0.50'` unchanged — is provenance-only and would have been mechanical on its own, but it does not govern the classification of the formula change.

triage.verifier_notes:
Caveats a reviewer should weigh:

1. The pre state is an intra-PR intermediate, not a shipped defect. Parent commit a9562cfd ("b1.6: generalize generated component surfaces", same PR #1300 branch `b1/incidence-flags`, merged 2026-08-17) is the commit that ADDED `COMPONENT_FORMULA_REPLACEMENTS` to tools/generate_schedule_compositions.py, already containing `"ieepa_component_rate": (("not entry_is_line_b", "not entry_is_section_232_aluminum"),)` — yet the generated YAML it committed still carried `not entry_is_line_b` while the sibling substitutions (aluminum component, §122) had been applied. The certify commit's generator diff touches ONLY the steel citation, so this module change is a re-emit that finally picks up a substitution the generator had already declared. The defective text therefore never reached main. If the corpus wants defects that shipped, this one is weak on that axis; if it wants encoded-meaning corrections at commit granularity, it qualifies.

2. The first reader's quote ("The generated compositions move from the witness's five per-line exemplar flags to membership-semantic caller inputs, and gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had.") is from the PR body and describes the PARENT commit's work, not this diff: the `ch99a_s232_steel_heading_rate` / `section_232_steel_component_rate` rules are already present in the pre file (a9562cfd), and this diff only re-points their citation strings. The reader's *reading* of the Brazil gate is correct; the quote is not decisive for this diff. I substituted the diff line.

3. The fix is partial against the source. The same note excepts 9903.01.77 duties for iron/steel (9903.81.87, .88 and derivatives .89–.93), aluminum derivatives (9903.85.04/.07/.08/.09), copper (9903.78.01), passenger vehicles and light trucks (9903.94.01/.03), and civil aircraft (9903.01.82) — the post gate excepts aluminum only. Also `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded` still reads `formula: entry_is_line_b` at line 1929 of the post file, so the exemplar coupling is not fully retired.

4. Minor tension worth flagging, not a defect: B16-C-REPORT.md says "Rev. 15 contains no operative 9903.81.x row", but the pinned corpus release (HTS Revision 3 (2026) notes, provisions file 2026-08-01-usitc-hts-2026-rev3-notes.jsonl) still prints 9903.81.87/.88 in note (x)(v). The parameter value stays 0.50 either way, so that half is provenance.
